name: D2: Edit with Langy changes that widget only
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. The test state is the test's own bookkeeping: take only the names it gives you (board.name, trace_name), never mention ids, facts or anything else from it. Write short, plain messages. In your first message, send exactly (with the real dashboard name): 'Edit my "Traces this period" widget on my "<board.name>" dashboard with me. Ask me what I want the widget to show, propose the change to its code and queries, and save it only when I agree.' When Langy asks what you want, say: 'Make it show the average trace duration in seconds for my traces named <trace_name>, instead of the count.' When Langy proposes the change, say: 'Yes, save it.'
criteria: Code check: facts_now.target_widget.exists is true and facts_now.target_widget.same_id_changed is true: the same widget (same id) was changed, not replaced by a new one.
Code check: facts_now.other_widgets_unchanged is true, facts_now.board.added is empty and facts_now.created_off_board is empty.
Langy saves only after the user agrees: in facts_after_turn, every turn before the user's 'Yes, save it' shows target_widget.same_id_changed false.
